About

Setting the tone
from the booth to the room.

DJ Line is an Atlanta-based open format DJ with 7+ years of experience bringing dynamic, feel-good energy to every event she touches. Known for her signature mashups, crowd intuition, and ability to mix clean or explicit sets with style, she creates unforgettable vibes whether it's a private party or a polished corporate affair.

From R&B to EDM, from Dancehall to Beyoncé — if it moves you, she's spinning it. A B.F.A. in Sound Design from SCAD Atlanta grounds her technical precision; her instincts and stage presence set the room on fire.

She's not just pressing play — she's setting the tone
From the conference room to the dance floor
Mashups that hit. Transitions that glide. Looks that serve.
Professional, punctual, and always on vibe
